CVE-2026-105437.description:
Affected versions of Git have a heap buffer overflow in the three-way merge
code (xdiff), which an attacker can trigger through a repository they
control.

When Git merges a file, it first adds up the size of the merged
output, allocates a buffer of that size, and then writes the output into
it. That total was kept in a 32-bit signed integer. The
conflict-marker-size attribute, which can be set from a committed
.gitattributes file, accepts any positive integer, and the markers are
written several times for every conflict. A small file with a huge marker
size and many separate conflicts can therefore push the total past 4 GiB,
so the integer wraps to a small value and Git writes attacker-controlled
merge output past the end of a buffer that is too small. At minimum this
crashes Git, and because the overflow is large and its contents are largely
attacker-controlled, worse heap corruption is possible.

Any command that does a textual three-way merge can trigger it, such
as git-merge(1), git-rebase(1), git-cherry-pick(1), and
git-merge-tree(1). The latter is most likely a target for Git forges,
which might use git-merge-tree(1) on the server-side to check
mergeability. When the server reads attributes from trees in the
repository (for example through attr.tree or --attr-source), any
user who can push branches and request that they be merged (for
example by opening a pull or merge request) can trigger the overflow
without anyone else doing anything, and the data they push is small
because the oversized output only appears during the merge.

The problem has been patched by computing the size as size_t and
checking every addition for overflow, so Git stops with an error
instead of overflowing.

Servers that cannot upgrade right away can add

* conflict-marker-size=7

to each repository's info/attributes as a workaround, which overrides
any in-tree .gitattributes, or turn off server-side mergeability checks for
untrusted repositories.

CVE-2026-98432.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period

tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock() transfers ownership of ireq->ireq_opt to the
child socket (newinet->inet_opt) without copying it.

Another cpu can concurrently process a retransmitted SYN for the same
request socket, and send a SYNACK from tcp_check_req().
tcp_v4_send_synack() and inet_csk_route_req() read ireq->ireq_opt
under rcu_read_lock() only, and ip_build_and_send_pkt() and
ip_options_build() then read opt->optlen twice.

Note that the SYNACK timer itself is not an issue: it holds a
reference on its request socket, and inet_csk_reqsk_queue_drop()
calls timer_delete_sync() before the child can be freed.

Since commit 079096f103fa ("tcp/dccp: install syn_recv requests
into ehash table"), request sockets are processed without holding
the listener lock, so nothing prevents the child socket from being
freed while the SYNACK is still being built. TCP child sockets do
not have SOCK_RCU_FREE, and inet_sock_destruct() frees inet_opt
with a plain kfree(), leading to a use-after-free in
ip_options_build().

A similar issue exists with request socket migration
(net.ipv4.tcp_migrate_req=1, or a BPF_SK_REUSEPORT_SELECT_OR_MIGRATE
program). reqsk_timer_handler() clones the request socket with
inet_reqsk_clone(), so that the old request socket and its clone
share the same ireq_opt, then reqsk_migrate_reset() clears the
pointer in the old one. Another cpu holding a reference on the old
request socket can still be using these options (sending a SYNACK,
or creating a child in tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock()) when the clone is
freed, and tcp_v4_reqsk_destructor() also uses a plain kfree().

Readers already use RCU, and other paths replacing inet_opt
(do_ip_setsockopt(), cipso_v4_sock_setattr()...) already use
kfree_rcu(). Use kfree_rcu() in inet_sock_destruct() and
tcp_v4_reqsk_destructor() as well.

IPv6 is not affected by the first issue, because tcp_v6_syn_recv_sock()
duplicates the options. tcp_v6_reqsk_destructor() has the same
migration issue with ipv6_opt, which is only set by CALIPSO. This
will be addressed in a separate patch.

CVE-2026-111190.description: The ARForms plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to arbitrary file upload in all versions up to, and including, 7.2.4 via its form file-upload handler. The name of the stored file is taken from an attacker-controlled request header and is not adequately restricted to safe file types, and the plugin's file-type and content-safety checks can be evaded, allowing files that contain executable PHP code to be written to a publicly accessible directory. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload malicious files to the affected site's server, which may make remote code execution possible. Exploitation requires a published form containing a File field to be publicly accessible on the site.

CVE-2026-91147.description: A flaw was found in `cockpit-ws`. This vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) by sending a specially crafted request. When the `WebService.UrlRoot` is configured and a request is made to the exact URL-root prefix without a trailing slash, `cockpit-ws` can terminate unexpectedly. This issue leads to the unavailability of the Cockpit web service.

posts.content:
PROXYGATE (CVE-2026-89103): Sicherheitslücke im SAP Gateway ermöglicht Codeausführung ohne Anmeldung

SAP hat mit dem Sicherheitshinweis Nr. 3798345 eine Schwachstelle im SAP Gateway geschlossen, die Angreifern ohne Anmeldedaten die Ausführung von Betriebssystembefehlen erlaubt. Ob ein System betroffen ist, hängt nicht allein von der Kernel-Version ab, sondern von der Proxy-Zugriffskontrollliste prxyinfo und dem Parameter gw/acl_mode_proxy.

https://shorturl.at/L7GOg

#sap #sapsecurity

CVE-2026-89103.description: SAP Gateway activates the default Access Control List with high privileges allowing categorization of external attacker as internal application server. As a result an unauthenticated attacker with network access to the SAP Gateway could exploit this weakness to potentially perform unauthorized actions within the application environment, resulting in a high impact on the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system.

CVE-2026-114432.description: The Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin before 6.2.4 does not validate the type or extension of files uploaded through a form file field, and a flaw in its temporary-file cleanup leaves the uploaded file on disk, allowing unauthenticated users to upload arbitrary files to the site. On a stock Debian or Ubuntu Apache configuration, which lists directory contents and maps .phar to the PHP handler, the stored file can be located and executed, leading to Remote Code Execution. On other configurations, including nginx and Apache with .htaccess overrides enabled, the issue is limited to an arbitrary file written into the uploads directory, which may still be served as active content such as HTML or SVG from the site's own origin.

posts.content: CVE-2026-77607: Semantic MediaWiki before 7.2.0 inserts the sep value verbatim into HTML cell joins, allowing HTML injection. CVSS 6.1. Patch under review - plan your upgrade to 7.2.0 now. #CVE #infosec #MediaWiki https://www.valtersit.com/cve/CVE-2026-77607/

CVE-2026-77607.description:
#### Failure mode `sep` was inserted verbatim into the HTML that joins a table cell's values. This made it possible to inject HTML through the separator value. The same unsanitised table HTML is produced both for the standard `Special:Ask` render and for its raw request output (`request_type=raw`), so the injection was reachable without authentication. #### Remediation - In all non-wiki output modes (HTML, raw request, file), `sep` is escaped unless it is a safe `
` variant. - This preserves legitimate line-break separators while blocking markup injection. #### Maintenance note If the table renderer ever gains richer separator semantics, keep the whitelist explicit. Do not expand the allowed HTML surface casually.

#React #ReactServerComponents #WebSecurity #Cybersecurity #InfoSec

CVE-2026-126187.description:
### Impact

Crafted payloads targeting frameworks supporting React Server Components can lead to remote code execution. This only affects extremely rare cases where responses transport multiple typed arrays and an attacker-controlled value.

Updating immediately is recommended.

The vulnerability exists in versions 19.0.0 through 19.0.8, 19.1.0 through 19.1.9, 19.2.0 through 19.2.8 and 19.3.0 of:

- react-server-dom-webpack
- react-server-dom-parcel
- react-server-dom-turbopack

### Patches

Fixes were back ported to versions 19.0.09, 19.1.10, 19.2.9, and 19.3.1.

If applications are using any of the above packages please upgrade to any of the fixed versions immediately.

If an app’s React code does not use a server, the app is not affected by this vulnerability. If an app does not use a framework, bundler, or bundler plugin that supports React Server Components, the app is not affected by this vulnerability.

CVE-2026-64670.description: Waline is a comment system with backend support. In versions 3.15.2 and prior, @waline/client renders the comment editor's live preview with marked and no sanitizer (utils/markdown.ts), and the preview is injected with v-html. When a comment is edited, the editor is seeded with the comment's raw, un-sanitized body (orig). Only administrators and the comment owner can edit. So an administrator who clicks Edit on an attacker's comment renders that attacker's raw HTML in their own session: an unauthenticated commenter achieves privilege-escalation stored XSS against a moderator with a single Edit click. At time of publication, there are no publicly available patches.

CVE-2026-20320.description:
A vulnerability in the Open Client Interface (OCI) XML Parser of Cisco BroadWorks could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system.

 This vulnerability exists because XML entries are improperly parsed due to external entity resolution being allowed by default. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted XML message to the Open Client Interface – Provisioning (OCI-P) service. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to view sensitive files from the filesystem with the privileges of the Cisco BroadWorks user.

posts.content: CVE-2026-84034: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 ships hardcoded credentials in hardware_assess/obstore, letting low-priv users recover master secrets and reach the internal database. CVSS 8.8, no patch yet - restrict access and monitor. https://www.valtersit.com/cve/CVE-2026-84034/

CVE-2026-84034.description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to a hardcoded credentials vulnerability in the hardware_assess/obstore binaries. A low-privileged authenticated user can recover hardcoded product master secrets, potentially resulting in unauthorized access to the internal database and compromise of sensitive system information.
